from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
from datetime import timedelta
from urllib.parse import parse_qs, urlsplit
import pytest
from pydantic import SecretStr, ValidationError
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric import ec
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives import serialization
from tests import conftest
from tests.test_modern_auth_service import make_modern, request, verify, challenge, VERIFIER
from tests.test_auth_apple_lifecycle import Gateway, APPLE
from app.services.auth_apple_lifecycle import AuthAppleLifecycle
from app.services.auth_provider_service import AppleNotification, ProviderIdentity, ProviderTokens
from app.schemas.modern_auth import ProviderStartRequest, ProviderCompleteRequest

with TemporaryDirectory(prefix='auth-security-review-') as directory:
    data = Path(directory) / 'data'
    data.mkdir()
    mp = pytest.MonkeyPatch()
    cg = conftest.container.__wrapped__(data, mp)
    container = next(cg)
    try:
        service, mail, sent, provider, clock = make_modern(container)
        owner = container.auth_service.seed_admin(email='relay@example.com', password='synthetic-long-password')
        owner = container.user_repo.mutate(owner.id, lambda user: user.model_copy(update={'email_verified_at':clock()}))
        _, token, _ = container.auth_service.login(email=owner.email, password='synthetic-long-password')
        created = (clock() - timedelta(days=1)).isoformat()
        with service.store.transaction() as c:
            c.execute('INSERT INTO auth_identity_bindings(id,user_id,provider,issuer,namespace,subject,created_at,updated_at,email,is_private_email) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,1)', ('apple-binding', owner.id, 'apple', APPLE, 'brainbuddy', 'apple-subject', created, clock().isoformat(), owner.email))
        gateway = Gateway()
        lifecycle = AuthAppleLifecycle(service.store, service.box, gateway, clock=clock)
        service.apple = lifecycle
        event_time = int(clock().timestamp())
        gateway.notification = AppleNotification('delivery-review', 'email-disabled', 'apple-subject', 'com.example.web', event_time, event_time, owner.email, True)
        lifecycle.process_notification('signed synthetic fixture')
        print('repro_disabled_relay_email_stays_usable:', service._email_usable(owner))
        pending = request(service, owner.email)
        dispatched = mail.dispatch_one()
        print('recheck_disabled_relay_dispatch:', dispatched)
        if dispatched:
            result = verify(service, pending.challenge_id, sent[-1][1])
            print('repro_disabled_relay_login_result:', result.payload.status)
        else:
            print('repro_disabled_relay_login_result: not_dispatched')
        gateway.notification = AppleNotification('revocation-review', 'consent-revoked', 'apple-subject', 'com.example.web', event_time, event_time)
        lifecycle.process_notification('signed synthetic fixture')
        try:
            methods = service.account_methods(raw_token=token)
            print('recheck_revoked_binding_safe_methods:', [(method.method, method.state, method.usable) for method in methods.methods])
        except ValidationError as error:
            print('repro_revoked_binding_breaks_account_methods:', [(e['loc'], e['type']) for e in error.errors(include_input=False)])
        clock.now += timedelta(seconds=1)
        key = ec.generate_private_key(ec.SECP256R1()).private_bytes(serialization.Encoding.PEM, serialization.PrivateFormat.PKCS8, serialization.NoEncryption()).decode()
        service.settings = service.settings.model_copy(update={'apple_team_id':'ABCDEFGHIJ','apple_key_id':'KLMNOPQRST','apple_private_key':SecretStr(key),'apple_services_id':'com.example.web','apple_native_app_id':'com.example.native'})
        identity = ProviderIdentity('apple', APPLE, 'apple-subject', owner.email, True, True, 'com.example.web', int(clock().timestamp()))
        provider.exchange_apple = lambda _code, **_kw: ProviderTokens(identity, 'com.example.web', SecretStr('synthetic-refresh'), 'refresh_token')
        started = service.start_provider('apple', ProviderStartRequest(purpose='login', client='web', client_challenge=challenge()))
        returned = service.provider_callback('apple', code='synthetic-code', state=started.payload.state, binder=started.binder)
        parameters = parse_qs(urlsplit(returned.url).fragment)
        try:
            result = service.complete_provider(ProviderCompleteRequest(attempt_id=parameters['attempt'][0], state=parameters['state'][0], handoff_code=parameters['grant'][0], client_verifier=VERIFIER))
            print('repro_fresh_apple_login_after_revocation:', result.payload.status)
        except Exception as error:
            print('repro_fresh_apple_login_after_revocation:', type(error).__name__)
        with service.store.connection() as c:
            print('recheck_binding_after_fresh_apple_login:', dict(c.execute('SELECT state,generation FROM auth_identity_bindings WHERE id=?', ('apple-binding',)).fetchone()))
            before = c.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM auth_apple_notification_receipts').fetchone()[0]
        container.account_service.purge_account(owner.id)
        with service.store.connection() as c:
            print('repro_notification_receipts_after_complete_purge:', {'before':before, 'after':c.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM auth_apple_notification_receipts').fetchone()[0], 'users':c.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users').fetchone()[0]})
    finally:
        try:
            next(cg)
        except StopIteration:
            pass
        mp.undo()

from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
from datetime import timedelta
from dataclasses import replace
import pytest
from tests import conftest
from tests.test_modern_auth_apple_integration import apple_runtime, native_login
from app.services.modern_auth_service import ModernAuthError

with TemporaryDirectory(prefix='auth-security-stale-consent-') as directory:
    data = Path(directory) / 'data'
    data.mkdir()
    mp = pytest.MonkeyPatch()
    cg = conftest.container.__wrapped__(data, mp)
    container = next(cg)
    try:
        service, mail, sent, provider, clock = apple_runtime.__wrapped__(container)
        first, _, _ = native_login(service)
        service.process_apple_notification('signed synthetic notice')
        clock.now += timedelta(seconds=2)
        provider.identity = replace(provider.identity, issued_at=provider.notification.event_time, email=None)
        try:
            native_login(service)
            print('recheck_equal_time_consent: unexpectedly accepted')
        except ModernAuthError as error:
            print('recheck_equal_time_consent:', error.code, error.status_code)
        with service.store.connection() as c:
            print('recheck_failed_consent_authority:', {'binding':dict(c.execute('SELECT state,generation FROM auth_identity_bindings').fetchone()),'sessions':c.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sessions').fetchone()[0], 'grants':c.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM auth_apple_grants').fetchone()[0], 'last_attempt':c.execute('SELECT status FROM auth_attempts ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1').fetchone()[0]})
        provider.identity = replace(provider.identity, issued_at=int(clock().timestamp()))
        fresh, _, _ = native_login(service)
        print('recheck_strictly_newer_consent:', fresh.payload.status, fresh.payload.user.id == first.payload.user.id)
    finally:
        try:
            next(cg)
        except StopIteration:
            pass
        mp.undo()
